{{Top|leg}}
A '''skipship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> They were outfitted with Rakatan [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and beam weapons powered by the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that focused [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> Their [[Force-drive|drives]] worked by zeroing in on worlds that had high Force concentrations.<ref name="TUR" />
